LanguageData.OverHaulers_Compatibility_Desc: Control how OverHaulers interacts with other caravan mass capacity stats, drivers, and external Harmony patches.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_DriverMode_Auto_Tooltip: Allows OverHaulers to dynamically select the optimal driver, prioritizing verified XML profiles, then explicit C# mod drivers, and falling back to bytecode inspection or Standalone mode as needed.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_DriverMode_Standalone_Toolti: Ignores all external mod stat drivers and runs purely as a direct postfix on MassUtility.Capacity.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CilScanIdleDesc: Dynamic bytecode inspection is idle. An active driver is already configured. Bytecode scanning disassembles external patch instructions and is only needed if an unlisted mod is not functioning properly.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_NoCandidateStatsInPatch: — No caravan-related stats detected in this patch.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_NoExternalPatchesDiscovered: No external C# mod patches detected on MassUtility.Capacity.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Display: 1 single unified entry: '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Gear: External mod gear (backpacks) and body ratings are merged cleanly into one calculation.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on any colonist to see the combined OverHaulers breakdown.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Display: 1 native entry: '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Gear: Standard vanilla gear calculations without external stat redirects.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on any colonist to view the biological body rating, bionics, and injury breakdowns.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Display: May show 2 separate listings: '{0}' alongside the external mod's stat under pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Gear: Both calculations safely sum when caravans form. No carrying capacity is lost.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Confirm: If you prefer a single unified entry, select 'Automatic Selection' above or choose a matching profile below.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Display: Hooked into '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Gear: Caravan mass capacity relies on this external stat hook.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on a colonist. If no OverHaulers breakdown appears or numbers do not update, select another candidate or revert to Automatic.
